value.content:
# situation: on push, in a private repository (repo.public false), a step
#   takes clientId and clientSecret out of the JSON secret
#   AZURE_CREDENTIALS into its env.
# reason: the runner masks AZURE_CREDENTIALS whole, not the values fromJSON
#   takes out of it, and prints the step's env in its header before it
#   runs, so the client secret is in the log as it is.
# attack: someone with read access to the repository, who may not read its
#   secrets, opens the run's log and reads the client secret.
# attack-run-behavior: the header of the step prints CLIENT_ID and
#   CLIENT_SECRET with their values; the log keeps them for 90 days by
#   default.
on: workflow_call
permissions: {}
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: log in to azure
        env:
          CLIENT_ID: ${{ fromJSON(secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS).clientId }}
          CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ fromJSON(secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS).clientSecret }}
        run: az login --service-principal -u "$CLIENT_ID" -p "$CLIENT_SECRET" --tenant contoso.onmicrosoft.com
